system_texts: Teletext is outdated, so that's off the list.
The remote will be used only for television, with no extra internet features; just the remote and the television.
The branding should incorporate our corporate image into the product, aiming for a fashion-forward electronics design using silver and yellow colours.

The remote will support two basic functions: inputting a channel/volume setting, and a location function, with location signals transmitted via radio (not infrared) to support no-line-of-sight, and the location finder can be activated via a button on the TV or on the wall.
The product will be a two-part package using DVD-type technology.
The group will include a power button and numeric controls, and avoid a hold-to-power mechanism or the absence of a dedicated power button to prevent user confusion.
gold_texts: A locator device separate from the remote will be incorporated into the design, which will operate with radio signal.
Speech recognition will not be used.
The group decided that their target marketing group would be mostly teenagers and young professionals.
The group put off building a stand or wall holder for the remote, because the locator function means the remote can be kept anywhere.
The locator function will not involve an LED indicator; the remote will simply emit a sound when located.
The main interface will include a power button.
The main interface will include a scroll wheel function in place of a number pad.
